allow_ssl.description: Allow SSL/TLS but do not require it (plaintext allowed if client declines TLS).

anon_max_rate.description: Max upload rate in bytes/sec for anonymous users (0 = unlimited).

anon_root.description: Directory to serve as root for anonymous users. Must exist and be owned by 'ftp'.

anon_umask.description: Umask for anonymous uploads (e.g., '077' → files 600, dirs 700 for security).

anon_upload_dir.description: Directory for anonymous uploads. Required for anon_upload_enable to take effect. Must be writable by the 'ftp' user.

anon_upload_enable.description: Allow anonymous users to upload files. Requires write_enable and proper directory permissions.

anonymous_enable.description: Allow anonymous FTP logins. Only enable if public file sharing is needed.

ascii_mode_upload.description: Enable ASCII mode uploads (auto-convert line endings).

banner_file.description: Path to file containing banner message (overrides ftpd_banner if set).

chroot_list_enable.description: Enable chroot exception list (users listed in chroot_list_file are exempt from chrooting).

chroot_list_file.description: Path to file containing users who should *not* be chrooted (if chroot_local_user=YES).

chroot_local_user.description: Chroot local users to their home directories for security. Prevents filesystem escape.

data_connection_timeout.description: Timeout for idle data connections (in seconds).

ftpd_banner.description: Banner displayed on initial FTP connection (e.g., welcome message).

guest_enable.description: Enable virtual users (requires PAM config mapping virtual users to system users).

guest_username.description: System user to map virtual users to (must exist).

hide_ids.description: Hide local user/group names in directory listings (shows numeric IDs instead).

listen.description: Run vsftpd in standalone mode (listening directly on ports).

listen_address.description: IP address to bind to (empty = all interfaces). Leave blank unless binding to specific interface.

listen_ipv6.description: Listen on IPv6 instead of IPv4 (if listen=YES and listen_ipv6=YES).

listen_port.description: FTP control port. Standard FTP uses 21.

local_enable.description: Allow local system users to log in via FTP.

local_max_rate.description: Max upload rate in bytes/sec for local users (0 = unlimited).

local_root.description: Root directory for local users after login. Use '$USER' for per-user home-based isolation.

local_umask.description: Umask for local users' uploaded files (e.g., '022' → files 644, dirs 755).

log_file.description: Alternate log file path (used when xferlog_std_format=NO).

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous clients. Set to 0 for unlimited.

max_per_ip.description: Maximum clients allowed per IP address.

pam_service_name.description: Name of PAM service for authentication (must match file in /etc/pam.d/).

pasv_enable.description: Enable passive FTP mode (required for clients behind NAT/firewalls).

pasv_max_port.description: Maximum port in the passive port range. Must be ≥ pasv_min_port. 0 = any port.

pasv_min_port.description: Minimum port in the passive port range. Ensure firewall allows this range. 0 = any port.

require_ssl.description: Require SSL/TLS for data connections (force encrypted file transfers).

rsa_private_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key (PEM format). If not set, the private key is expected to be in the same file as the certificate.

ssl_ciphers.description: Cipher suites to permit. Restrict to strong ciphers (e.g., AES-GCM, ChaCha20).

ssl_enable.description: Enable FTP over SSL/TLS (FTPS). Strongly recommended for production.

ssl_protocols.description: SSL/TLS protocols to allow. Use spaces or commas to separate. Avoid SSLv3, TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1.

syslog_enable.description: Log to syslog instead of file-based logs.

tcp_wrappers.description: Use TCP Wrappers (/etc/hosts.allow, /etc/hosts.deny) for access control.

timeout.description: Idle session timeout in seconds (0 = no timeout).

user_config_dir.description: Directory containing per-user config files (named by username).

user_sub_token.description: Token used to substitute virtual usernames in paths (e.g., /home/vsftpd/$USER).

utf8_filesystem.description: Assume filesystem uses UTF-8 encoding (helps with international filenames).

virtual_user_config_dir.description: Directory for per-virtual-user config files (used when guest_enable=YES).

virtual_users.description: Virtual users and their per-user settings. Each key is a virtual username, value is a dict of config keys. Only relevant when guest_enable=YES and user_sub_token is set.

write_enable.description: Allow FTP write operations (uploads, deletes, renames). Disable for read-only FTP.

xferlog_file.description: Path to the transfer log file.

xferlog_std_format.description: Use standard wu-ftpd-style log format (for compatibility with log analyzers).
